task.title: P6-085: Make + Want undoable via a desire-quantity operation and toast action
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 5 — Missing capability). Original id: P6-085. Size: M. Specs: specs/collection-api.md, specs/app-ui.md.

**`+ Want` cannot be undone.** Undo is the `moves` ledger's `undone_at` flag, but `add_desire` writes no ledger row and the trait exposes no desire-quantity operation to compensate with — desires can only be added, board-relabeled, or cascade-deleted with their collection. So the catalog quick-add's Want toast deliberately ships **without** an Undo action while Have has one. Needs `set_desire_quantity(desire_id, SetQuantity) -> Option<DesireLine>` on `CollectionStore` mirroring `set_holding_quantity` (0 deletes the row), both backend implementations, a `POST /api/desires/{id}/quantity` route + path constant, then wire the toast's action. Note the quick-add adapter has no desire id today — `QuickAddReceipt` carries only `undo_move_id` (`shared/collection.rs:461-462`), so it must carry the desire id back for the toast to target.
